purpose: Acquire a larger scene-separated NYU mirror subset while keeping disk use bounded
selection_details: Offsets evenly spaced through each shard; up to 24 complete HDF5 files at evenly spaced positions inside each bounded window. Scene split occurs after acquisition using a seeded shuffle of sorted names; not a uniform random frame or scene sample.
validation: Check exact decoded RGB matches against local evaluation; retain failed ranges and report unknown near-duplicate and evaluation-scene overlap.
limitations: No independent upstream per-member checksums or full shard downloads; tar range validity and local sample hashes do not prove upstream dataset identity.
